questions.question: Which Indian was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in the year 1930?
questions.solution:
• Nobel 1930: C. V. Raman
  • Science: He won the Nobel Prize for his groundbreaking work on the scattering of light (The Raman Effect).

questions.question: The Pitts India Act of ______ distinguished between the commercial and political functions of the British East India Company.
questions.solution:
• Pitt’s Act Dual Control: 1784
  • Detail: The act ensured that the political control of India was in the hands of the British Government, while trade remained with the Company.

questions.question: Swami Vivekananda’s death anniversary is observed on ______.
questions.solution:
• Vivekananda's Death: July 4
  • Fact: He passed away in 1902 at the age of 39 while meditating at Belur Math.

questions.question: Which among the following is the oldest High Court in India?
questions.solution:
• Oldest High Court: Calcutta
  • 1862: The High Court at Calcutta was established under the Indian High Courts Act, 1861, followed by Bombay and Madras.

questions.question: In which of the following cities of the Indus valley civilization has a dockyard been found?
questions.solution:
• Lothal Dockyard: Lothal
  • IVC Trade: This artificial brick dockyard connected the city to an old course of the Sabarmati River, facilitating maritime trade with Mesopotamia.

questions.question: Qutub Minar is an example of ______ architecture.
questions.solution:
• Indo-Islamic Architecture: Indo-Islamic
  • Qutub Minar: It combines Islamic elements like calligraphy and geometric patterns with Indian craftsmanship and floral motifs.

questions.question: When was Alluri Sitarama Raju arrested ending a two-year armed tribal struggle?
questions.solution:
• Rampa Rebellion: May 1924
  • Leader: Alluri Sitarama Raju led a tribal guerrilla war in the Eastern Ghats until his capture and execution in 1924.

questions.question: Qawwali was brought in India from ______.
questions.solution:
• Qawwali Origin: Persia
  • Culture: Though it has Persian roots, Qawwali evolved into its modern form in the 13th century through the work of Amir Khusro in India.

questions.question: Gandhiji, aged ______, arrived in India in 1915 from South Africa.
questions.solution:
• Gandhi's Age 1915: 46
  • Context: Gandhi was born in 1869; his arrival in India followed two decades of perfecting his political philosophy in South Africa.

questions.question: Ain-i Akbari, a document on life of Mughal ruler Akbar does not contain information about ______.
questions.solution:
• Ain-i Akbari Content: Ancestors
  • Detail: While the Akbarnama covers ancestors in its first volume, the Ain-i Akbari (3rd volume) focuses strictly on the empire's administration and statistics.

questions.question: On learning about the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, ______ expressed the pain and anger of the country by renouncing his knighthood.
questions.solution:
• Renouncing Knighthood: Rabindranath Tagore
  • 1919: Tagore wrote a famous letter to the Viceroy stating that the 'badges of honor make our shame glaring' after the brutal Amritsar massacre.
